 Counsel for the Petitioner: Sri C Sumon  Counsel for the Respondent Nos. 1 & 3: GP for Roads & Buildings Counsel for the Respondent Nos. 5 to 7: GP for Revenue  Petition under Section 151 CPC praying that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed in support of the petition, the High Court may be pleased to direct the Respondents not to interfere with my peaceful possession and enjoyment of land and structures in an extent of Ac.0.07 cents situate in Sy.No.93 of Piler Village and Mandal, Annamayya District, owned and possessed by the petitioner, without paying compensation.
Pending disposal of WP No.29566 of 2024, on the file of the High Court.

The court while directing issue of notice to the Respondents herein to show cause as to why this application should not be complied with, made the following order.(The receipt of this order will be deemed to be the receipt of notice in the case).
The Court made the following ORDER

The writ petition is filed questioning Award No.6 of 2023, dated 30.08.2023 passed by the 6*^
respondent.
It is stated that similarly situated persons like that of the petitioners approached to this Court by filing Writ Petition No.41326 of 2022, in respect of the very same survey number.
Whereunder, this Court by order dated 22.12.2022, directed the respondents not to take any coercive steps against the petitioners therein.
Copy of the said order is filed along with I.A.No.1 of 2024.

Taking into consideration of the submissions made by the counsel for the petitioners, there shall be an interim direction to the respondents not to take any coercive steps against the petitioners in respect of subject property.
